title: MMV product audit and v0.2.0 release record
text: MMV R-first toolkit water-maze minefield trajectory plots. baseline implementation working task-specific plotters, onboarding, batch diagnostics, generated help, Unicode-path verification, optional Python boundaries, direct publishing behavior sufficiently explicit ordinary users. product audit identified user-facing risks: new user discover several low-level functions producing first plot; malformed CSV manifest rows produce errors without enough context; recursive conversion non-ASCII filenames reliably exercised Windows locales; Python hook maintained reference module versioned contract; direct publishing helpers encourage unsafe commits pushes; pkgdown site generated help drift source package.

title: MMV product audit and v0.2.0 release record
text: mmviz_init() creates editable starter project rolls back newly created files initialization fails part-way . plot_mmviz() provides one entry point preserving existing task-specific plotting APIs. Batch output collisions reported manifest row stop later independent jobs. Batch input paths expand ~ manifest-relative resolution, output collision keys respect case-sensitive POSIX filesystems. Output directory creation checked errors include actionable paths. Unicode regression tests require UTF-8-capable R locale document Windows C.UTF-8 environment failure mode without changing global settings. use_python_backend() deprecated v0.2.x compatibility scheduled removal v0.3.0; pure-R plotting supported path. Direct-push publisher scripts removed favor protected-branch PR tag-based release workflows.

title: MMV
text: Run installed end--end example: Repository contributors can run source("scripts/run_examples.R") template conversion, water-maze, minefield, batch examples source checkout.
code: library(MMV)  # Easiest first run: create data templates, a manifest, and a runner. mmviz_init("my-mmv-project") # Then run: Rscript my-mmv-project/run_mmviz.R  wm_csv <- system.file("templates", "watermaze_template.csv", package = "MMV") mf_csv <- system.file("templates", "minefield_template.csv", package = "MMV")  # 1) Read and plot immediately plot_mmviz(   wm_csv,   task = "watermaze",   cfg = list(     style_mode = "builtin",     out_file = "outputs/watermaze_demo.png"   ) )  # 2) Convert to the standard schema when you want a reusable clean CSV cnv <- convert_mmviz_csv(   path = wm_csv,   out_path = "outputs/watermaze_template_standard.csv",   task = "watermaze",   overwrite = TRUE )  # 3) Plot the converted file plot_watermaze(   cnv$output_file,   cfg = list(     style_mode = "builtin",     plot_mode = "line_gradient",     out_file = "outputs/watermaze_demo.png"   ) )  # 4) Minefield (heatmap + optional trajectory overlay) plot_minefield(   mf_csv,   cfg = list(     style_mode = "builtin",     overlay_trajectory = TRUE,     out_file = "outputs/minefield_demo.png"   ) ) source(system.file("examples", "example_usage.R", package = "MMV"))

title: MMV 0.2.0
text: Stabilized one-command onboarding rollback partial initialization failures clearer output-directory errors. Added manifest duplicate-output detection row-numbered batch failures. Added Windows UTF-8 troubleshooting locale-aware Unicode path tests. Deprecated optional Python hook compatibility; pure-R plotting remains supported path hook scheduled removal 0.3.0. Added real-data fixture geometry-regression hooks, pending author-provided anonymized files redistribution permission. Reworked CI pkgdown publishing around pull requests, coverage, tagged releases; direct-push publisher scripts longer supported.

title: MMV 0.1.0.9000
text: Added mmviz_init() one-command starter projects plot_mmviz() unified plotting entry point. Added Getting Started article pkgdown site. Fixed installed package test entry point generated complete help pages every exported function. Made batch manifests resolve relative inputs manifest directory report failures per row without aborting later jobs. Preserved recursive source subdirectories Unicode filenames folder conversion prevent output collisions. Tightened schema plot-configuration validation actionable errors. Accepted signed, decimal, scientific-notation legacy coordinates preventing malformed standard CSV files misclassified legacy streams. Added cross-platform R CMD check automation installed-package example.
